def process(g):
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for comp in components(g):
        if len(comp)<9: continue
        cur=set(comp); seq=[]
        while True:
            o,inner=layers(list(cur))
            if inner is None: break
            seq.append((g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]],list(o)))
            cur=set(inner)
        if not seq: continue
        for idx,(c,ringcells) in enumerate(seq[::-1]):
            for y,x in ringcells:
                res[y][x]=c
    return res

def peel(g, cells):
    ys=[x[0] for x in cells]; xs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    rem=set(cells); seq=[]
    while True:
        if not rem: break
        cur={(y,x) for y,x in rem if (y==y0 or y==y1) and x0<=x<=x1 or (x==x0 or x==x1) and y0<=y<=y1}
        if not cur:
            seq.append((g[y0][x0],list(rem))); break
        seq.append((g[y0][x0],list(cur)))
        rem-=cur
        inner={c for c in rem if y0<c[0]<y1 and x0<c[1]<x1}
        if not inner: break

        y0,y1,x0,x1=ny0,ny1,nx0,nx1
